animation.glide: Make ONE production animation sheet of Rei with EXACTLY 8 full-body frames. Use the reference for identical character, outfit, rendering and pose. Layout is TWO columns by FOUR rows on a portrait canvas, read row by row. WIDE EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTERS between every cell. Each character must be SMALLER, occupying ONLY 65% of the cell height and no more than 70% of its width. Keep every last hair tip, fingertip and boot completely inside the cell. No overlaps, no clipping. Smooth floating/gliding LOOP with small consecutive changes: arms rise and fall gently, knees alternate flexing, skirt hem and bow tails follow, long hair waves from the roots to the gold/violet tips with a slight time lag. The first and last poses join into a continuous cycle. Same front three-quarter angle and face, same scale and head size, stable torso anchor in every frame. Do not just duplicate one drawing: all eight drawings are distinct small motion increments. Preserve long indigo hair, gold star clip on viewer-left, purple eyes, white/purple/gold star idol dress and waist bow, white boots. Clean anime cel shading, chibi proportions. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background everywhere outside the character: no gradient, glow, scenery, ground, shadows, grid lines, numbers, text or labels. 2 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, exactly 8 figures, generous empty margins.

Small connected steps, readable smooth arc, never unrelated poses. No physical screen, magic effects, wings, scenery, ground, shadows, labels, text or grid lines. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no colors behind sprites.
